cases.name: valid
cases.why: the golden document, cold start

cases.name: valid_previous_key
cases.why: signed by the previous document key, still pinned

cases.name: valid_newer_than_cache
cases.why: a higher version than the cached one

cases.name: unchanged_same_bytes
cases.why: equal version, identical bytes: a no-op refresh

cases.name: expiry_boundary
cases.why: now is exactly expires_at_ms + 300000

cases.name: non_string_doc
cases.why: doc is a JSON object, not a string

cases.name: malformed_sig_hex
cases.why: sig in uppercase hex

cases.name: short_sig_hex
cases.why: a 63-byte sig

cases.name: envelope_duplicate_member
cases.why: kid given twice

cases.name: envelope_extra_member
cases.why: a fourth envelope member

cases.name: envelope_missing_member
cases.why: no kid member

cases.name: envelope_not_object
cases.why: the envelope is a JSON array

cases.name: envelope_bom
cases.why: a UTF-8 BOM before the envelope

cases.name: kid_not_base64url
cases.why: kid is 43 characters but carries '+' (base64, not base64url)

cases.name: kid_short
cases.why: kid is 42 base64url characters

cases.name: oversized
cases.why: the golden envelope padded with spaces to max_document_bytes + 1

cases.name: at_cap
cases.why: the golden envelope padded with spaces to exactly max_document_bytes (trailing JSON whitespace)

cases.name: lone_surrogate_doc
cases.why: doc carries a lone-surrogate escape: it has no UTF-8 encoding

cases.name: unknown_kid
cases.why: signed by a key that is not pinned

cases.name: forged_sig
cases.why: signature bit flipped

cases.name: wrong_tenant
cases.why: signed for another tenant (domain message and body)

cases.name: tenant_newline
cases.why: the configured tenant carries a newline (outside the CP grammar); validly signed for it

cases.name: wrong_domain
cases.why: signed under the CP tenant-config domain

cases.name: doc_duplicate_member
cases.why: doc_bytes gives version twice (validly signed)

cases.name: doc_not_object
cases.why: doc_bytes is a JSON array (validly signed)

cases.name: v2
cases.why: v is 2

cases.name: wrong_kind
cases.why: kind names another document

cases.name: body_tenant_mismatch
cases.why: signed for the configured tenant, body names another

cases.name: version_too_large
cases.why: version is 2^53

cases.name: version_not_integer
cases.why: version is a string

cases.name: rollback
cases.why: version lower than the cached one

cases.name: version_conflict
cases.why: equal version, different bytes

cases.name: window_invalid
cases.why: expires_at_ms equals issued_at_ms

cases.name: expired
cases.why: now is expires_at_ms + 300001

cases.name: experiments_not_array
cases.why: experiments is an object

cases.name: unindexable_missing_key
cases.why: an experiment without key

cases.name: unindexable_experiment_id
cases.why: an experiment whose experiment_id is a number

cases.name: duplicate_key
cases.why: two experiments share a key

cases.name: duplicate_experiment_id
cases.why: two experiments share an experiment_id

cases.name: duplicate_decision_point
cases.why: two experiments share a decision_point

cases.name: key_collides_decision_point
cases.why: a key equals another experiment's decision_point

cases.name: unknown_enum
cases.why: mode is an unknown string: document accepted, that experiment config_invalid

cases.name: bad_salt_hex
cases.why: salt_hex in uppercase: document accepted, that experiment config_invalid

cases.name: bad_arm_bundle
cases.why: an arm without bundle: document accepted, that experiment config_invalid

note: each case runs verify_document(body, case.tenant or tenant, pinned_doc_keys, now_ms, cached), where body is the UTF-8 envelope, then, when pad_to_bytes is set, 0x20 bytes appended until it is pad_to_bytes long; a refusal keeps the cache (R8.11)
